Most app founders in 2026 are chasing the wrong number: views. They celebrate a video that hits a million, then wonder why downloads barely moved.

Meanwhile, apps with smaller videos are quietly converting better, because they understand what happens in a viewer's head between the scroll, the App Store search, and the paywall.

I've spent the last few years talking to over 700 app founders and studying the content, onboarding, and paywalls behind their growth, from CocoPix (30M+ views on prank videos that weren't their best converters) to Cal AI (2,000+ influencers with cost per download going down) to apps hitting $1M ARR profitably.

This is everything I've learned about why people download an app, and why they decide to pay.

You'll learn:
1️⃣ Why CocoPix's 30M-view prank videos lost to simple before-and-after content
2️⃣ The "main character" rule: how to make your app the star of the video without it feeling like an ad
3️⃣ Content-market fit, and why the best hook is describing a problem in your viewer's exact words
4️⃣ Why showing up on the For You page again and again drives App Store searches instead of fatigue
5️⃣ How onboarding gets users ready to pay before they've really used the app
6️⃣ The funnel disconnect no clever annual-plan anchor can fix, and the metrics that actually matter

Topics this video covers: app growth, app marketing strategy, how to grow an app, how to market an app on tiktok, ugc app strategy, app onboarding, paywall optimization, subscription app paywall, how to get app downloads, content market fit, consumer app growth
